purpose: Singular Value Decomposition with φ-weighted singular values
description: Computes the SVD of a matrix (A = UΣV^T), then weights singular values by φ^(-i) to emphasize dominant components with golden ratio decay.

signatures.candid: linalg_svd : (vec vec float64) -> (record { U: vec vec float64; S: vec float64; V: vec vec float64 })
signatures.javascript: async svd(matrix: number[][]) -> { U: number[][], S: number[], V: number[][] }

input_types.name: A
input_types.constraints: Any matrix. Does not need to be square.

output_type.description: U (m × m), S (min(m,n) φ-weighted), V (n × n)

numerical_caveats: Singular vectors may differ by sign convention
For rank-deficient matrices, some singular values will be zero
φ-weighting emphasizes first singular values more strongly

when_not_to_use: Square matrices where eigen decomposition suffices
Very large sparse matrices (use specialized sparse SVD)
